name: tutorial-step
title: Tutorial step
description: One step of a sequence, with the way forward attached. "Step 2 of 5" rides `data-gs-step` and `data-gs-max`, the same attribute progress uses, because "step 2 of 5" and "2 of 5 segments filled" are the same idea. `data-gs-active` is where the sequence has got to, which is not `data-gs-selected`: the player did not pick it and cannot unpick it. A finished sequence carries `data-gs-complete` and shows a tick, so completion is never a colour alone. Locked keeps its shape and its way forward shows a padlock. Its controls are `button`, in document order, and it neither takes focus nor holds it. Performs nothing: it does not advance itself or decide when a sequence is done.
docs: Pass `step` and `max` for the position, and render every step of the sequence rather than only the current one: `active` says which the sequence is on, `complete` says which are behind it. Pass `onNext` and `onBack` to get the controls; a step with neither renders no actions. Pass `locked` for a step that opens later, which keeps its shape and puts a padlock on the way forward while leaving it focusable. It imports `./button`, which is the flat path a `gamestage-ui add` produces, and `@gamestage/button` is what puts the file there.
